tool_args.rationale: Fit a two-branch saturating flux law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation. The observed horizon and other state variables are fixed, so their effects are not identified by these measurements.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The discriminating observations show substantial gradient dependence.
The pilot response saturates strongly with increasing input.
The available trajectory batch has already been acquired; its rows add input and gradient variation but do not vary horizon or initial state.
